test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India declares that the seat of Supreme Court is in Delhi?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Article 130__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 130 of the Indian Constitution declares that the Supreme Court seat sits in Delhi.
 
• The Supreme Court of India sits in Delhi or Any other Place in India Only if the Chief Justice of India, may with the approval of the President of India.
 
• This provision of the Indian Constitution is only optional and not compulsory. 
 
• The Supreme Court of India includes the Chief Justice and 33 other Judges appointed by the President of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some Important Articles Related to the Supreme Court:
 
 
• ​Article 124-Establishment of Supreme Court.
 
• Article 125-Salaries of Judges.
 
• Article 126-Appointment of acting Chief Justice. 
 
• Article 127-Appointment of ad-hoc judges.
